diagnostic.incidentTitle: Apache HTTPD Upstream 502/504 Gateway Timeout & Worker Saturation
diagnostic.rootCause: Apache mod_proxy failed to read status line from remote upstream 198.51.100.42 requested by client john.doe@company.com. Server reached MaxRequestWorkers limit.
remediationSteps: Increase ProxyTimeout from 60 to 120 seconds in httpd.conf for upstream 198.51.100.42.
Increase ServerLimit and MaxRequestWorkers in mpm_event.conf to handle peak concurrency.
Inspect network socket connections and health on 198.51.100.42.
Gracefully reload Apache: apachectl -k graceful.

diagnostic.incidentTitle: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff & OOMKilled Memory Limit Reached
diagnostic.rootCause: Container in pod 10.244.3.44 was terminated with exit code 137 (OOMKilled). The application memory usage exceeded container resource limit (1024Mi) while serving traffic from upstream svc_checkout@finance.internal.
remediationSteps: Increase container memory limit in deployment manifest from 1024Mi to 2048Mi for pod 10.244.3.44.
Inspect heap dump and memory leak traces using kubectl logs 10.244.3.44 --previous.
Check readiness probe thresholds for service svc_checkout@finance.internal to prevent cascading pod restarts.
Apply updated deployment configuration: kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml.

finalReport.incidentTitle: Kafka Broker Leader Partition Loss & Rebalance Storm
finalReport.rootCause: Broker heartbeat timed out (session.timeout.ms=10000). ZooKeeper / KRaft metadata lost quorum synchronization, causing partition replica out-of-sync (ISR shrinkage) and consumer group rebalance loops.
remediationSteps: Inspect broker disk I/O and JVM GC pauses: tail -n 100 kafka-server-gc.log.
Increase max.poll.interval.ms from 300000 to 600000 to prevent premature consumer ejection.
Verify topic partition ISR status: kafka-topics.sh --describe --under-replicated-partitions.
Trigger controlled leader re-election: kafka-leader-election.sh --election-type preferred.

finalReport.incidentTitle: WebLogic Server Thread Deadlock & DataSource Pool Exhaustion
finalReport.rootCause: WebLogic Server execute threads entered STUCK state (BEA-000337) waiting for response from backend database pool. Connection pool reached MaxCapacity (100) and timed out after 30000ms.
remediationSteps: Increase JDBC Connection Pool max capacity: configure MaxCapacity=150 in weblogic-ra.xml.
Investigate long-running uncommitted SQL queries blocking thread workers via WLST: threadDump().
Tune StuckThreadMaxTime from 600s to 300s to enable early alert signaling.
Execute graceful server restart: ./stopWebLogic.sh && ./startWebLogic.sh.
